title: PowerShell Security Monitoring
content: Monitor PowerShell execution logs for encoded commands, suspicious parent-child process relationships, and execution from unusual directories.

title: Brute Force Detection
content: Multiple failed authentication attempts from a single source within a short time window may indicate password spraying or brute-force activity.

title: Malware Incident Response
content: When malware is detected, isolate the affected host, preserve forensic evidence, identify persistence mechanisms, and perform threat hunting across the environment.

title: DNS Tunneling Detection
content: Indicators of DNS tunneling include unusually long domain names, high query volume, high entropy subdomains, and communication with suspicious domains.
